description: This Kotlin source file contains utility functions and classes for the FDroid Android application, including QR code generation, string manipulation, time formatting, UI padding adjustments, safe URI handling, and system inset application.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for UI-related tasks such as applying system bar insets to views.

methods.name: generateQrBitmapKt
methods.description: Suspending function that generates a QR code bitmap from given data using coroutines.

methods.name: String.flagEmoji
methods.description: Extension property that converts a two-letter country code string into its corresponding flag emoji.

methods.name: Long.asRelativeTimeString
methods.description: Extension function that returns a relative time string for the timestamp.

methods.name: PaddingValues.copy
methods.description: Composable extension function to create a copy of PaddingValues with optional overrides.

methods.name: UriHandler.openUriSafe
methods.description: Function that safely opens a URI, catching and logging exceptions.

methods.name: UiUtils.setupEdgeToEdge
methods.description: Static method to apply system bar insets to a view for edge-to-edge UI.
